Mali.title: OPERATION DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa [Malian Armed Forces] are stepping up security operations in Diabaly, Anefis, Tonka and Indelimane
Mali.summary: Several terrorist groups neutralised, vehicles and motorcycles destroyed: The Malian Armed Forces continue their surveillance, reconnaissance and security operations on several fronts across the national territory. Illustrative image BAMADA.NET – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to defend and protect the national territory.

Mali.title: Mali – FAMa: 24 soldiers freed from the hands of the enemy following an airborne operation; General Oumar Diarra commends their resilience
Mali.summary: MALI: GENERAL OUMAR DIARRA ENCOURAGES SOLDIERS RELEASED AFTER THEIR CAPTIVITY – THE FAMa REAFFIRM THEIR COMMITMENT TO SERVING THE NATION Lieutenant General Élisée Jean Dao, Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, at the reception for the 24 released FAMa soldiers, 23 November 2023 . Bamada.net – Military solidarity, loyalty to the homeland and determination to defend Mali's territorial integrity were the focus of a particularly important meeting on Monday, 23 November 2026.

Mali.title: Purchasing power in Mali: The transitional authorities' successful offensive brings down the price of meat
Mali.summary: In the face of the high cost of living, which was weighing heavily on household budgets, the government's strategy is finally bearing fruit. Gathered in Bamako on Monday, 16 November 2026, around the Minister of Industry and Trade, Moussa Alassane Diallo, stakeholders in the livestock-meat sector welcomed a significant drop in prices at market stalls, a direct result of the courageous decisions taken by the Transitional Authorities.

Mali.title: THE SECURITIES OF 23 NOVEMBER 2026
Mali.summary: - The 31st Conference of the Parties on Climate Change concluded last Friday in Antalya, Türkiye. At the end of ten days of discussions, observers consider the outcome to be disappointing. - Several towns in the country were targeted by armed men last Saturday in Niono, Bandiagara and Gao.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The army announces strikes in four sectors
Mali.summary: The Malian army claims to have carried out several operations on Sunday, 22 November 2026 in the sectors of Diabaly, Anéfis, Tonka and Indelimane. According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, these operations resulted in the neutralisation of several terrorists and the destruction of vehicles and motorbikes. .

Mali.title: FAMA Operations: Surgical strikes...
Mali.summary: FAMA Operations: Surgical strikes in Kidal and Niono Several positions of armed terrorist groups have been targeted in recent days by precision strikes in the vicinity of Kidal and around Niono. . These operations, which are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, are continuing in order to neutralise any remaining threats in these localities.

Mali.title: Refoulement from Guinea: Phew! The humanitarian crisis has been contained
Mali.summary: Triggered without warning on 2 November 2026 by the unilateral ban on artisanal gold mining in Guinea's Siguiri region, the wave of hundreds of thousands of gold panners forcibly expelled to Mali and Burkina Faso has put a severe strain on border stability and the reception capacities of our countries. .

Mali.title: MSF condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health centre in Mali
Mali.summary: On Saturday, 21 November, in Mali, attacks targeted the village of Arabebe, near Niafounké, in the north of the country, as well as Niono, in the Ségou region, in the centre of the country. Two people lost their lives, including a health worker. In addition, two health workers, two caregivers, and a child under five were wounded, all inside Niono hospital.

Mali.title: Release of around thirty soldiers: The bold move by FAMa
Mali.summary: Around thirty soldiers from the Malian Armed Forces were released last week following a spectacular operation led by the Special Forces and their Russian allies. A successful bold move in the north of the country: combat and transport helicopters, Sukhoi aircraft and the latest-generation drones were deployed in this high-intensity mission, which confirms the growing strength of the FAMa and increasingly affirms Mali's sovereignty over its entire territory every day.

Mali.title: Burkina Faso–Mali military cooperation: Burkinabé trainee officers immersed in Malian military institutions
Mali.summary: On Friday, 20 November 2026, the trainee officers of the 2nd class of the Burkina Faso Staff College carried out a series of visits to several Malian military institutions, as part of their study trip to Mali. The information was made public by the Malian Armed Forces . The delegation visited, in particular, the Directorate of Military Colleges, the General Staff of the Armed Forces and the Ministry of Defence and Veterans' Affairs.

Mali.title: MSF Mali attacks: MSF strongly condemns deadly attacks against civilians and a health facility
Mali.summary: This Saturday, 21 November, in Mali, attacks targeted the village of Arabebe near Niafounké, in the north of the country, as well as Niono, in the Ségou region, in the centre of the country. Two people lost their lives, including a health worker. In addition, two health workers, two carers and a child under five were wounded, all inside Niono hospital.

Mali.title: Occupied Palestinian Territory Emergency Response Activity Update #61, 1 - 31 October 2026 [EN/AR]
Mali.summary: SITUATION OVERVIEW October marked both one year since the October 2025 ceasefire and three years since the escalation of hostilities. The humanitarian situation in Gaza remains dire and extremely fragile, with humanitarian partners warning that funding shortfalls, combined with ongoing Israeli restrictions, have begun to reverse the gains achieved since the ceasefire was announced.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Vivo Energy simulates an accident between two tankers to test its safety system
Burkina Faso.summary: An accident involving a tanker carrying fuel and a gas tanker, followed by the outbreak of a fire and the treatment of casualties. This was the full-scale scenario that the teams from Vivo Energy Burkina and their partners took part in on Thursday, 19 November 2026, at the company's gas depot in Bingo. .

Burkina Faso.title: Image Published on 23 November 2026 Africa Burkina Faso: RSF denounces a "new wave of repression" against the media The NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounced on Monday a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso, where the junta recently issued arrest warrants…
Burkina Faso.summary: The NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounces a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso against the media. On Monday, the NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) denounced a "new wave of repression" in Burkina Faso, where the junta recently issued arrest warrants against journalists and banned the publication of an investigative media outlet. .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso/Agriculture: A fire destroys more than four hectares of rice in Bossora
Burkina Faso.summary: A fire ravaged more than four hectares of rice in a field in Bossora, a village in the municipality of Satiri, in the Houet Province, on Friday, 20 November 2026, according to our colleagues at the AIB. The fire caused significant losses for the producers, although its exact circumstances are not yet known. .

Niger.title: Algerian soldiers in the Niger desert... from withdrawing ambassadors to crossing borders
Niger.summary: On Friday, 30 October 2026, circulating images showed an Algerian convoy near the customs office in the town of Arlit in northwestern Niger, comprising dozens of fuel tankers and guarded by military vehicles. Reuters quoted ten sources as saying that the first Algerian military convoy had arrived in the town, located about 200 kilometres from the border, marking the first publicly announced deployment of Algerian forces outside the country since the October 1973 war.

Niger.title: Dosso/Presidential initiative for 1,000 boreholes in the municipalities of Koygolo and Kiota: The Minister of Agriculture and Livestock visits the irrigated sites of Dallol Bosso
Niger.summary: On 19 November 2024, the Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, Colonel Bilaly Gambobo, accompanied by the Governor of the Dosso Region, the Director General of ONAHA, the Director General of Rural Engineering, key officials from the Ministry, regional directors, and officials from the Defence and Security Forces, visited several irrigated sites developed under the Presidential Initiative 1,000.

Niger.title: Diffa/Security: 17 weapons, 3 Hilux vehicles seized, and 6 traffickers apprehended on the Diffa-N'Guigmi road.
Niger.summary: It was as part of Operation Nalewa Dolè and in fulfilment of its sovereign duties to protect people and their property that the Traffic Brigade achieved this feat. The ceremony to present this haul to the regional authorities took place on 17 November 2026 at the Command Legion of the National Gendarmerie. .
